content: Fasting blood glucose levels in individuals with gestational diabetes mellitus (GDM) should be maintained below 95 mg/dL (5.3 mmol/L). One hour after consuming a meal, blood glucose levels should remain below 140 mg/dL (7.8 mmol/L). Two hours after consuming a meal, blood glucose levels should be kept below 120 mg/dL (6.7 mmol/L). These glycemic targets are established based on clinical guidelines for managing preexisting diabetes during pregnancy.
